call.text: The authors’ architecture uses a two‑stage hierarchical design in which a routing module dynamically draws chunk boundaries and a downsampler retains vectors based on those indicators, forming the first level of hierarchy, and a de‑chunking layer with a smoothing module and upsampler restores the compressed vectors, forming the second level [HNET:1:c012]. The authors report that H‑Net (2‑stage) is significantly better than H‑Net (1‑stage), indicating that adding a second stage helps [HNET:3.1:c049].
